kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Borrowed from Middle Persian [script needed] (lwcynk' /⁠lōzēnag⁠/, “almond sweetmeat, marzipan”); in the alternative forms relating to the name of the walnut Middle Persian [script needed] (gwzynk' /⁠gōzēnag⁠/, “walnut sweetmeat”), well known in Georgian გოზინაყი (gozinaq̇i). See Classical Persian لوزینه (lawzīna) for more.
